certificate.scope: Exact P0 known-law minimum including take and finish. R2 equals minimum; R1 adds max(6,ceil(minimum/2)); R0 uncapped. Goal breaks count operations unsetting at least one matched coordinate, minimized over all successful words. Null restricted cost means unreachable under bank-contiguous words. Coupled optimum beats every bank-contiguous word; slack may permit such a word. Sizes and horizon strata are not empirical difficulty calibration.
